title: Tooling
spec: Add eslint (typescript-eslint, react-hooks), prettier, vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom. Scripts: lint, typecheck (tsc -b), test, format. One passing smoke test for App. Keep build green.

title: netlify.toml + CI
spec: Add netlify.toml (build 'npm run build', publish 'dist', functions 'netlify/functions', SPA redirect /* -> /index.html 200, security headers incl. CSP allowing image.tmdb.org, youtube embeds, picsum). Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running lint/typecheck/test/build on push+PR. Add netlify/functions/health.ts returning {ok:true}. Install @netlify/functions.

title: Router + layout
spec: Install react-router-dom. src/app/router.tsx with lazy routes: / (Home = current App content), /title/:type/:id, /search, /my-list, /profiles, /account, /plans, /genre/:id, 404. AppLayout keeps Navbar, aurora, footer. Navbar links become NavLinks. Keep existing glass UI working.

title: zustand store
spec: Install zustand. src/state/store.ts with persisted slices: profiles (active id, list), watchlist per profile, history per profile, ratings per profile. localStorage persistence keyed 'lastframe'. Typed selectors and hooks in src/hooks/.

title: Service adapters + mock fixtures
spec: Create src/services/{types.ts,index.ts,tmdb/mock.ts,tmdb/live.ts,auth/mock.ts,auth/live.ts,db/mock.ts,db/live.ts,billing/mock.ts,analytics/mock.ts}. index.ts picks live when import.meta.env.VITE_TMDB_PROXY / VITE_SUPABASE_URL are set, else mock. Live files may be stubs that throw 'not configured' for now. Mock TMDB: ~60 fictional titles with TMDB-shaped fields (id, media_type, title/name, overview, poster_path, backdrop_path, genre_ids, vote_average, release_date, runtime) and image URLs from picsum seeds; genres list; search filters by title. Migrate src/data/movies.ts consumers to the service.

title: Design tokens + primitives
spec: Refactor src/styles/theme.css into tokens.css (colors, glass, radii, motion easings/durations) + theme.css. Add primitives in src/components/ui/: Skeleton (shimmer), Toast provider + useToast, Button variants, IconButton, focus-visible rings. Keep visuals identical to current site.

title: Wave 0 integration
spec: Integration pass: make sure all wave-0 pieces work together (router+store+services+tokens), lint/typecheck/test/build all pass, fix any breakage. Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describing the layout.

title: TMDB live service
spec: Implement src/services/tmdb/live.ts against a proxy base URL (VITE_TMDB_PROXY, default '/.netlify/functions/tmdb'): trending(all/day), popular, topRated, upcoming, byGenre, genres, search(query, filters), details(type,id) with append_to_response=credits,videos,similar,recommendations,watch/providers. Typed responses in types.ts. Image URL helper w/ sizes.

title: Netlify TMDB proxy
spec: netlify/functions/tmdb.ts: forwards ?path=... and query to https://api.themoviedb.org/3 with TMDB_API_KEY from process.env (server only), 10-min in-memory cache, cache-control headers, allowlist of paths, error JSON. Never expose key. Document in docs/KEYS.md.

title: Home rows from service
spec: Home page rows driven by the tmdb service (mock or live): Trending, Popular Movies, Popular TV, Top Rated, New & Upcoming, 3 genre rows. Loading skeleton rows, error state with retry. Cards link to /title/:type/:id.

title: Hero with trailer preview
spec: Hero pulls from trending; after 3s on a slide, if a YouTube trailer key exists, fade in a muted autoplay YouTube embed behind the glass card (lite: iframe only when visible). Mute toggle. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (no autoplay).

title: Title page
spec: /title/:type/:id: backdrop w/ fade, glass info panel (title, year, runtime, rating, genres, overview), actions (Play trailer -> modal, +My List, Rate), cast strip (horizontal), Similar row, Where to watch (providers by region US/CA with JustWatch attribution). Skeleton + not-found state.

title: Search page
spec: /search?q=: navbar search navigates here; debounced input; filters (type movie/tv, genre, year range, min rating) as glass chips; grid of cards; infinite scroll via IntersectionObserver; empty and error states.

title: Genre browse
spec: /genre/:id page with genre name, paginated grid, sort control (popularity/rating/date). Genre chips on Home linking here.

title: Wave 1 integration
spec: Integration pass across wave-1 pages: navigation works, service switching works, all checks pass. Fix regressions.

title: My List
spec: Add/remove from card hover, title page, modal. /my-list page grid, empty state, toast on add. Persisted in store.

title: Continue watching
spec: Track viewed titles (title page open / trailer play) into history with timestamps; 'Continue Watching' and 'Recently Viewed' rows on Home; clear-history in Account.

title: Ratings
spec: Thumbs up/down + optional 5-star on title page and card hover; stored per profile; 'Because you liked X' row on Home built from top-rated titles' similar lists.

title: Profiles
spec: /profiles 'Who's watching?' screen with glass avatar tiles, add/edit/delete profile, avatar picker (gradient avatars), kids flag. Active profile in navbar; all per-profile state switches.

title: Auth adapter
spec: Install @supabase/supabase-js. auth/live.ts: magic link + Google OAuth via Supabase; auth/mock.ts: fake session in localStorage. AuthProvider, /account page (sign in/out, email, delete data), guest mode default. Never crash when no keys.

title: Supabase schema + sync
spec: supabase/schema.sql: profiles, watchlist, history, ratings tables keyed by auth.uid with RLS policies; seed.sql. db/live.ts syncs store <-> Supabase when signed in (debounced upsert, initial pull, last-write-wins). db/mock.ts no-op.

title: Plans page + billing adapter
spec: /plans page with 3 glass plan cards (Free/Plus/Premium), feature table, CTA. billing/types.ts BillingAdapter interface (getPlans, startCheckout, getSubscription); billing/mock.ts stores fake subscription. NO Stripe SDK, no Stripe keys.

title: Wave 2 integration
spec: Integration pass across wave-2 features; all checks pass; fix regressions.

title: Unit tests
spec: Vitest coverage for services (mock adapters, live URL building), store slices, hooks, Row/MovieCard/Search components. Target 70% lines on src/services and src/state.

title: Playwright e2e
spec: Install @playwright/test; playwright.config.ts using executablePath from PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH fallback; smoke: home loads rows, search finds a mock title, add to My List persists after reload, title page opens, profiles switch. npm run e2e. Add to CI as separate job.

title: Error boundaries + offline
spec: Route-level ErrorBoundary with glass error card + retry; global offline banner (navigator.onLine); fetch retry with backoff in services.

title: PWA
spec: vite-plugin-pwa: manifest (name Last Frame, theme #0b0b12), generated icons from an SVG logo mark in public/, service worker with runtime caching for images; install prompt button in Account.

title: SEO + brand
spec: Per-page <title>/meta/OpenGraph via a small useMeta hook; public/favicon.svg + logo mark component (LF monogram, glass style); robots.txt; sitemap for static routes.

title: Performance
spec: Route code-splitting verified, image srcset/lazy, preconnect to image hosts, prefetch on card hover, bundle analysis; document results in docs/PERF.md.

title: Accessibility
spec: Keyboard nav for rows (arrow keys), focus trap in modals, ARIA labels/roles, skip link, contrast check on glass text, reduced-motion audit. Document in docs/A11Y.md.

title: Analytics adapter
spec: analytics/types.ts (track, page), mock logs to console in dev, plausible.ts adapter enabled by VITE_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN; page views on route change, events for search/add-to-list/play-trailer.

title: Docs
spec: README.md (what it is, run, deploy), docs/KEYS.md (every env var, where to get it, where to set in Netlify), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md refresh, docs/AGENTS.md task log appended.

title: Wave 3 integration
spec: Final integration pass: lint/typecheck/test/e2e/build all green; grep dist for any secret; fix regressions.
